project.name: exo-discord
project.description: Go-native Discord bot runtime, MCP server, and CLI for AI agent participation in Discord servers

hooks.command: jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty' | while read -r file_path; do [ -f "$file_path" ] || continue; case "$file_path" in *.go) gofmt -w "$file_path" ;; esac; done
